author: Vincent Chow
description:
American artificial intelligence (AI) giant Anthropic has accused its Chinese AI rivals DeepSeek and Moonshot on Thursday of covertly routing customer requests to its Claude models, then showing users the responses as if they were from their own models.
The new allegations mark a further escalation in US criticism of China’s AI industry practices. Earlier this week, three US government agencies, including the National Security Agency (NSA) and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), claimed...
title: Moonshot, DeepSeek secretly routed user requests to Claude, Anthropic claims

author: Dewey Sim,Khushboo Razdan,William Zheng
description:
Beijing is weighing plans to send a group of top tech, electric vehicle and aerospace executives to accompany Chinese President Xi Jinping to Washington later this month, as the two sides race to finalise details for the closely watched visit.
The South China Morning Post first reported on August 28 that Chinese and US officials were negotiating whether business leaders would join Xi’s delegation to the US. However, details about who might be included have not been previously reported.
According...
title: Tech, EV and aerospace executives likely to join Xi’s US trip to mirror Trump team

author: Igor Patrick
description:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held talks in Peru on Thursday on countering Beijing’s growing footprint around the strategic Chancay megaport, drawing a sharp response from China’s embassy in Lima, which defended its investments and took aim at Washington’s strict visa rules.
Rubio met President Keiko Fujimori at the Government Palace, where she confirmed Peru would join the Shield of the Americas, a US-led coalition against organised crime. The Peruvian capital was the last stop of a...
title: China rebuts top US diplomat Marco Rubio over ‘Communist Party-backed projects’ in Peru

author: Zhang Tong
description:
Chinese scientists have developed a way to generate a fourfold increase in power output of hydrogen fuel cells, an advance that could broaden their use from road vehicles to space missions.
Hydrogen is widely viewed as a promising clean energy source for a low-carbon future. Fuel cells convert the chemical energy in hydrogen directly into electricity, producing water as their only exhaust.
In a study published in the peer-reviewed journal Science on Thursday, researchers at the Beijing Institute...
title: Chinese scientists boost hydrogen fuel cell power fourfold with new design

author: Vincent Chow
description:
Key witnesses are expected to testify in Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies’ landmark criminal case on Thursday in Brooklyn, New York, as it enters its second day of testimony.
It comes after a US government lawyer told federal jurors on the opening day that Huawei engaged in criminal activities to achieve “growth at any cost”, while a lawyer for the company said that Huawei employees deemed to have broken company policies were punished for their actions.
Brian Heberlig, of US law firm...
title: Huawei racketeering trial enters second day of testimony

author: Vincent Chow
description:
A key witness is expected to testify on Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies’ alleged theft of trade secrets from Japanese rival Fujitsu on Thursday as the company’s landmark criminal trial in Brooklyn, New York, enters its second day of testimony.
It comes after a US government lawyer told federal jurors on the opening day that Huawei engaged in criminal activities to achieve “growth at any cost”, while a lawyer for the company said that the employee who photographed Fujitsu networking...
title: Huawei racketeering trial turns to alleged trade secret theft from Japan’s Fujitsu

author: Gabriel Dominguez
description:
As China expands its submarine fleet, the US Navy is looking to develop a compact air-launched torpedo that could enable more crewed and uncrewed aircraft to attack submarines from farther away.
The US Naval Air Systems Command issued a request for information – a step towards development – to industry in late August for the Silent Anvil Air-Launched Torpedo (SAA-LT).
While air-launching a torpedo from stand-off range is not new – the US Navy already has the High Altitude Anti-Submarine Warfare...
title: US Navy plans compact Silent Anvil torpedo as China’s submarine fleet surges

author: Lawrence Chung
description:
Taiwan’s representative office is among a list of entities US President Donald Trump has threatened to sue as part of his crusade against a progressive American think tank, triggering debate about the island’s US policy ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington later this month.
Trump named the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office (Tecro) in a social media post on Monday attacking the Centre for American Progress, a prominent left-leaning Washington think tank,...
title: Trump threatens Taiwan’s representative office, sparking debate over island’s US policy

author: Liu Zhen
description:
Japan’s plan to develop tactical satellites equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) would boost its long-range offensive strike capabilities and pose a serious threat, Chinese state media has warned.
The Japanese Nikkei newspaper reported last week that the planned AI-equipped satellites would be capable of analysing surveillance intelligence in space. The aim is to speed up targeting decisions and strengthen the country’s “counterstrike capability”, such as missile guidance.
According to the...
title: Japan’s AI satellites and other space ambitions ‘a serious threat’, China warns

author: Amber Wang
description:
The American delegation to the Xiangshan Forum, a major Chinese security conference in Beijing, will be led by US Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defence for China, Taiwan and Mongolia Cynthia “Xanthi” Carras, the South China Morning Post has learned.
More to follow...
title: US delegation to Xiangshan Forum to be led by senior Pentagon official for China

author: Dewey Sim
description:
China has confirmed that President Xi Jinping will travel to New Delhi for the Brics summit this weekend, his first visit to India in close to seven years and the latest leg of the Chinese leader’s busiest run of summitry in years.
China’s foreign ministry said Xi would attend the summit at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Xi is expected to have a sit-down with Modi on the sidelines of the summit.
The Chinese president’s visit to India follows closely on a packed diplomatic...
title: China’s Xi Jinping to make first trip to India in 7 years for Brics summit

author: Cao Jiaxuan
description:
With its sweeping victory in a key state election, the far-right Alternative for Germany is putting pressure on the ruling federal coalition and could nudge Berlin towards a more pragmatic approach to China, analysts said.
By securing 43.8 per cent of the vote in the September 6 election in Saxony-Anhalt – more than double its 2021 result – the AfD sent shock waves and piled further pressure on Chancellor Friedrich Merz and his Christian Democratic Union (CDU) party.


In the state it has...
title: Far-right AfD party won big in Saxony-Anhalt. Will it affect Germany’s approach to China?

author: Cao Jiaxuan,William Zheng
description:
A foreign cargo ship caught fire on Thursday morning while docked for repairs in the eastern Chinese city of Qingdao, causing heavy casualties, state broadcaster CCTV reported.
The blaze started at around 11.15am at the state-owned Qingdao Beihai shipyard, the report said. It did not say how many were killed or injured.
President Xi Jinping has given orders to step up search and rescue efforts, according to CCTV, a rare instance of instructions from the top leadership accompanying an accident...
title: ‘Heavy casualties’ after foreign cargo ship catches fire in China’s Qingdao

author: Brian Rhoads,Raymond Ma
description:
China signalled a willingness to help set up a meeting between US President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, the South China Morning Post reported exclusively.
Beijing is playing an “active” and “constructive” role in rebuilding US-North Korea diplomacy, the SCMP said on Thursday, citing unidentified people familiar with the matter. A Trump-Kim meeting could potentially take place at the November Apec summit in Shenzhen, China, one person said. A US envoy visited the city and...
title: China ready to help Trump meet North Korea’s Kim

author: Phoebe Zhang
description:
Two laboratories in central China have been shut down for alleged surrogacy activities, an underground practice that persists despite repeated crackdowns.
On Wednesday, the health bureau in Changsha, Hunan province, said six people were detained after a tip about a “laboratory that illegally uses assisted reproductive technologies”, according to state news agency Xinhua.
A day earlier, the Wuhan Municipal Health Commission, in neighbouring Hubei province, announced that an illegal lab had been...
title: Why is surrogacy in China proving so difficult to ban despite the crackdown?

author: Chao Kong
description:
China’s next-generation combat aircraft will be able to fly by themselves if a pilot loses consciousness, navigate without satellite signals and operate in self-reorganising large drone formations.
That is the plan laid out by researchers from the Shenyang Aircraft Design & Research Institute, a top Chinese military aircraft design organisation, in a paper last month.
The institute is associated with the development of the Chinese next-generation aircraft commonly referred to as the J-50, which...
title: J-50 designers reveal leapfrog tech for China’s next-gen stealth fighters

author: Han Li
description:
US President Donald Trump kicked off the Republican Party’s midterm campaign season in Dallas on Wednesday night, headlining the opening of a highly unusual convention aimed at rallying voters ahead of November’s high-stakes battle for control of Congress.
“This has been the most successful two years financially and every other way in the history of the presidency,” he said, as the crowd chanted “USA! USA!”
In the almost two-hour-long speech, Trump also made a bold promise to give every adult...
title: Trump touts ‘most successful’ presidency, promises US$5,000 to citizens in speech

author: William Zheng
description:
China’s ruling Communist Party has signalled a renewed push for social stability by quietly setting up a high-level party group about a year ahead of its 21st national congress.
The creation of the Leading Group for Social Governance of the party’s Central Committee underscores the growing focus on internal security and grass-roots governance ahead of the next five-yearly congress, expected to be held in autumn 2027.
Beijing has never officially announced the formation of the body, nor disclosed...
title: China’s Communist Party quietly signals social stability push with new high-level body
